title: Birth in McCall, Louisiana, 1892
summary: Born May 19, 1892 in Assumption Parish; light banter about age.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: the string bass. Now, Pops, let's get a little background on you. Where were you born?

McCall, Louisiana, or Assumption Parish. I said Louisiana, that's about 68 miles from New Orleans, going towards Baton Rouge. I was about to say that was west. Yes. What year? 1892. 19th day of May. See, now this is, see 19, the next one ought to be 65.
Uh-huh. Well, you certainly look in marvelous shape. You're in great shape. I hope I look
as good as you do when I'm 65. Well, let's make it to me. Let me see how you look when you get 35. I don't care if it's wounded or let me see. Well, it was.
